item.title: Reflectionblog
item.description:
INTRODUCTION In this reflection blog, I will describe what we learned in our lab sessions.

Lab1: Wiki and Markdown

In the first lab we learned about Wiki and Markdown. The markdown tutorial sheet was given and we practiced writing in Markdown using exercises from that sheet. We also practiced writing content using Markdown such as headings, bold and italics ,links etc. Through this we learned that Markdown is the easiet way to write a well structred documents without even requiring any kind of editing tools. Then we installed zettler that is a Markdown editor so that we can do editing in Markdown and apply htese concepts. There we wrote few mathematical expressions using Latex format in zettler. Overall,this exercise helped us to know how content can be formatted using Markdown and how wiki pages store and share information and how zettler can be used for editing in Markdown. In this reflection blog, I described what we learned across our lab sessions and how these activities helped build both technical and conceptual understanding.
